title: Grain Accounting Bulletin: What a Written Change Leaves a Contract Committing on a Short Crop
content:
A member on Grain Marketing Contracts whose crop has come in short of the bushels they sold is amended in writing rather than left to run into default, and one amendment does two things at once: it moves the last day of the delivery window out by the full extension allowance the member's marketing programme carries, counted in calendar days from the last day the contract currently calls for, and it restates the bushels the contract commits.

**The restated commitment.** The bushels the amendment leaves the contract committing are the bushels its tickets credit plus the retained share of the shortfall, struck in whole bushels, a part bushel taken to the nearest whole bushel and a half bushel taken upward, and they are never fewer than the net bushels the tickets standing against the contract, whatever the disposition, carry, since bushels already in the pit cannot be cut away.

**The shortfall.** The shortfall is the bushels the contract commits before the amendment less the bushels its tickets credit, never below zero.

**What is not touched.** An amendment does not touch the bushels still owed on the contract: those follow the loads the member directed to the contract at the scale and are not restated here.

**The credit and the two figures brought to it.** Only the tickets received at the facility the contract calls for are credited, at the net bushels written on them. The credited bushels are then reduced by the hold shrink, which is nil, and the retained share of the shortfall is the whole of it.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A contract commits 20,000 bushels. The tickets standing against it, whatever the disposition, carry 14,000 net bushels in all, of which 12,000 were received at the facility the contract calls for and 2,000 elsewhere.

| Step | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Bushels the tickets credit, being the tickets received at the contracted facility | 12,000.00 |
| Hold shrink taken off them | nil |
| Bushels the contract commits before the amendment | 20,000.00 |
| Shortfall | 8,000.00 |
| Retained share of the shortfall, being the whole of it | 8,000.00 |
| Credited bushels plus the retained share, struck in whole bushels | 20,000 |
| Net bushels the tickets standing against the contract carry, whatever the disposition | 14,000.00 |

The restated commitment is 20,000 bushels, that being the greater of the two final figures. Had the sum before the striking come to 19,999.50, it would be struck at 20,000, the half bushel being taken upward. The last day of the delivery window moves out from the last day the contract currently calls for by the full extension allowance the member's marketing programme carries.
